notes: Security and reliability overhaul: the Windows updater no longer uses CMD or ping loops and now performs one bounded, verified swap with rollback; Electron windows use isolated preload bridges and strict navigation/CSP controls; Discord sessions expire and relay privileges use revocable per-account tokens; relay and accounts deployment is TLS-first and loopback-only; failed tunes, PTT races, audio resources, net nesting, channel naming, and relay-persisted metadata have been repaired.
